title: fix(app-shell): the permission-set pages send the holder's package to the grant, clone and activation doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuJoin9eHMoErkpuTUddz1Fj)_

Fixes #32537

## 维护者速读

- 问题：权限集按 (包, 名) 识别（ADR-0150 D4）。两个包持有同名权限集时，只带名字的请求会被服务器以 409 拒绝。Setup 与 Studio 页面只发名字，所以够不到这种权限集。
- 改法：页面列出同名的多个持有者时，激活开关带 `?package=`，克隆带 `?package=`，授予带 `permission_set_package`。授予列表、台账和环境范围的编辑器按（包，名）读，读法与服务器的规则一致。
- 409 带候选时：显示服务器原话，每个持有者一个按钮，由管理员选。选了再按所选包重发。⛔ 不按顺序替人选。
- 一个持有者（CONTROL）：所有请求与界面不变，真栈上已录下请求形状。
- 只用通用组件（AlertDialog、Button），没有新的产品专名组件。没有放宽任何安全或权限行为。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）审过三轮。专题席红线复读第一轮未通过（停用确认少计覆盖职位的用户；环境范围编辑器不按持有者限定，Remove 可能碰到别的持有者的授予行），两处都已修好并加 pin 和消融；第二轮补上"已发布列表读失败时不画按持有者限定的块"，在 da12ea26 上判 PASS（6831559566）。i18n 只加键，按默认档复核通过（6831566565）。复读里的小问题已转跟进卡 #32774，下拉框两持有者的问题在 #32770。CI 绿后按队列落地。

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

A permission set is identified by `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D4). With more than one holder of a name, a request that names only the set is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and every holder is listed in `details.candidates` (#32306).

The shared module `views/metadata-admin/permission-set-holder.ts` holds the readings. A page names a package only when the name alone does not address the set (`addressingPackageOf`): the page must list more than one holder, and the holder must be a package. The environment's own set is addressed by its name, which is the set a caller with no package is served. Each stored row is read by the server's own rule:

- a grant by `permission_set_package`: the column, else the environment's set, else the one holder, else nothing;
- a ledger row by core's `ledgerRowHolders`: a row that two holders refuse keeps every holder off;
- a position from the package that declared it. The anchors and environment positions are the environment's reference. A declaring package that holds no set of the name is judged by its dependencies on the server, so it is listed and counted.
- a position served under a package that holds the name counts for that package's set and for the environment's reference. The server reads an overlay or `.custom` override of a package's position as the environment's reference (core `security-catalog.ts`, `referenceCaller`), and serves it under the package's `_packageId`. The served item does not say which one it is, so the deactivation confirm never says fewer people than lose access.

| Surface | Change |
|---|---|
| Activation (`catalog-activation.ts`, `CatalogActiveSwitch.tsx`, `ResourceListPage.tsx`) | `writeCatalogActivation(type, name, enabled, packageId?)` sends `?package=` for `permission` only, and a 409 that names candidates rejects as `PermissionSetHolderConflict`. `readCatalogLedger` keeps each permission row with its `package_id`. On the environment-scope list, each holder's row reads `isCatalogHolderActive` and writes its own package. The item page's switch shows a refusal as a pick and keeps the picked holder. |
| Grants (`AssignedUsersSection.tsx`, `setup/CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx`, `setup/peopleAssignments.ts`, `setup/PermissionSetAssignmentPage.tsx`) | Setup → Permission set assignment lists one entry per holder with the holder said beside it, and `?package=` goes in the link. A bare `?set=` for such a name picks nothing. The section gets the holding: the same by-name read, filtered per grant and position, and Add writes `permission_set_package`. |
| Clone (`permission-set-clone.ts`, `PermissionSetCloneDialog.tsx`) | `sourcePackage` is sent as `?package=`, with the body still exactly `{ name, label }`. A refusal naming the holders shows an inline pick. |
| Editor (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `SetupAssignmentsLink.tsx`) | In the environment scope the editor reads which holder it shows (`holdingOfRead`): the package its read named, else the environment's own set. Its Assigned users section and its active switch get that holding, and its Setup link names the holder's package. Where two packages hold the name and the read named neither, the server refuses the read, and the editor draws neither the section nor the switch. It draws neither as well when its published list cannot be read, since it then cannot tell how many holders the name has. So no by-name union of every holder's grants is listed, and Remove cannot reach another holder's row. |
| Deactivation count (`catalog-holders.ts`, `positionReach`) | Counts the switched holder's people through the same reads, including a package's position for the environment's own set. |
| Pick (`PermissionSetHolderPick.tsx`) | Inline and AlertDialog faces, built from `@object-ui/components` only. |
| i18n | `perm.holder.pick.*` (studio en and zh), and `setupAssignments.setsHolderPackage` / `setsHolderEnvironment` in all 11 Setup locales. `gen:zh-hant` reports the zh-Hant pack is current. |

## Live check (showcase on `os dev`, code at `4ea1cf24`, console rebuilt there)

This was run on the first round, at code `4ea1cf24`, squashed into `4a5c5829`. The second round (`c28c6598`, after the epic red-line read 6829073582) and the third (`da12ea26`, after the delta read 6830782363) change the editor's sections and the position reading. They were not re-run live; they are pinned by the tests and the ablation legs below.

Evidence is in `/mnt/project-files/issue-32537/live/` (`evidence.json`, 12 screenshots, `rig.js`).

**CONTROL** (real stack, one holder of every name, nothing mocked). Every request is the name alone, as on `main`:

```
200 POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/showcase_auditor {"enabled":false}
200 POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/showcase_auditor {"enabled":true}
200 GET  /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set?top=500&filter=["permission_set","=","showcase_auditor"]
200 POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/showcase_auditor/clone {"name":"auditor_copy_control","label":"Auditor copy (control)"}
```

The Setup assignment link is `?set=showcase_auditor`: one entry, no holder line.

**Two holders.** On `main` the one-holder rule still stands until #31698 PR-2, so the registry list was mocked to serve a second `showcase_auditor` under `com.example.other`. The doors are real. The real door's own `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal drives the pick:

```
409 POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/showcase_auditor?package=com.example.other {"enabled":false}
      → details.candidates [{kind:package, packageId:com.example.showcase}]  → pick shown, nothing more sent
200 POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/showcase_auditor {"enabled":false}          ← after the pick (one holder: the name addresses it)
200 POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/showcase_auditor?package=com.example.showcase {"enabled":true}
200 GET  /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set?top=500&filter=["permission_set","=","showcase_auditor"]   ← ?set=showcase_auditor&package=com.example.showcase
```

**Clone pick.** The bare-name refusal is mocked in the door's envelope shape, and the retry goes to the real door:

```
409 POST …/permission-sets/showcase_auditor/clone   (mocked: two candidates)
200 POST …/permission-sets/showcase_auditor/clone?package=com.example.showcase
```

Screenshots: `06-two-holders-door-refusal-pick.png` (the dialog, in the server's words), `05-two-holders-list.png` (a switch per holder), `10-two-holders-assignment-picked.png` (an entry per holder, with the picked holder's grants and its position holder), `11-clone-refusal-pick.png` (the inline pick).

## Tests

New pins are top-level describes in the existing harness files, plus `permission-set-holder.test.ts` and `PermissionSetCloneDialog.holderPick-32537.test.tsx`. Each covers CONTROL (the same requests), the two-holder requests, the 409 pick with nothing sent until a choice is made, and the environment pick sent by the name alone.

On head `da12ea26`:

- 93 test files and 747 tests pass across the touched app-shell suites (every test file that imports a touched module, `views/setup/`, and every test of `PermissionMatrixEditor` and `SetupAssignmentsLink`). New in the second and third rounds: `PermissionMatrixEditor.holderSections-32537.test.tsx` (5 cases, one for an unreadable published list), a count pin in `catalog-holders.test.ts`, a host-holding pin in `CatalogActiveSwitch.itemPage-28578.test.tsx`, and `holdingOfRead` / `positionReach` pins in `permission-set-holder.test.ts`.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: 102 files and 1894 tests pass on `a0724ef2`, and the second round changes no locale file. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` and root `check:i18n` pass.
- `type-check` passes for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.
- The 38 gate families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives all exit 0. `--ran` reconciles 38 of 38, with 0 NOT-MEASURED.

Ablation used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with 13 legs: clone query, clone environment pick, clone conflict, activation query, activation conflict, keyed ledger reading, list row package, grant filter, Add column, position reach, keyed count, per-holder entries, and handing on the holding. Each leg ran its pin red, then restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The logs are in `/mnt/project-files/issue-32537/ablation*.log`. One leg found a real bug before commit: a default parameter made the environment pick resend the host's package. The second and third rounds add 8 legs, each red and then restored the same way (`ablation3.log`, `ablation4.log`, `ablation5.log`): the position counted for the environment, the editor's section holding, the editor drawing no section for an unaddressed read, the area switch's holding, the item switch seeding the host's holding, the Setup link's package, and both arms of an unreadable published list (a refused read, and an answer that is not a list).

## Acceptance notes

- **The editor's first read names a package only when its URL does.** In the environment scope it shows the package `?package=` names, else the set the name addresses (the environment's own, or the one holder). Its sections follow that holder. A two-holder refusal of its switch is shown as the pick.
- **An unreadable published list draws nothing holder-scoped.** The editor cannot then tell how many holders the name has, so it draws neither the Assigned users section nor the active switch, whatever the holder count. The Setup link stays, and Setup's own page reads the holders itself. That read failing is the only change to a one-holder screen.
- **A package's position is listed under the environment's set too.** It is display-only there (no Remove on a position row), and it is what keeps the deactivation confirm from under-counting.
- **Grant refusals on `/data` carry no candidates (#32250).** So a refused Add shows the server's sentence, not a pick. The Setup page sends the package for every package holder it lists, so it does not meet that refusal.
- **`permission-ref` (`RegistryRefField`) is display-only and stays by name.** It draws a stored name's label. After #31698 PR-2 two holders of one name will share an option key there. That is noted for its card, not changed here.
- **Studio's design area strips `?package=` in the environment scope (#32615's surface).** It is not touched.
- **A position whose declaring package holds no set of the name is listed and counted, not judged.** The server resolves it through that package's declared dependencies, which the page does not read, so the confirm never says fewer people than lose access.
